content_sections.heading: Central Railway Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the Central Railway Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download Central Railway Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Central Railway Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 23-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Railway Advocate posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 23rd October 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the minimum educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an LL.B. degree from a recognized university and have a minimum of 3 years of experience as an Advocate.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for Railway Advocates?
faq.answer: There are a total of 33 vacancies announced for the Railway Advocate positions across various locations under Central Railway.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is through email. Candidates need to send their applications via email to the designated address.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for these posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the job type for these Railway Advocate positions?
faq.answer: The positions are contractual in nature, meaning they are offered on a fixed-term contract basis.

faq.question: Q7. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by Central Railway.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this Central Railway recruitment is 01/2026.

faq.question: Q9. What are the key stages in the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves shortlisting of applications, followed by a personal interview, document verification, and background verification.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' heading.
